# Copilot instructions

## Documentation sources

The general documentation about this project and architecture can be found in [the contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
When doing any changes beyond Markdown text edits, add this documentation to context to understand the project's technology stack and guidelines.

## Localization approach

The default language for the documentation is English.
Some pages are localized into French, using the `fr` suffix in the documentation structure.
When doing content edits, ensure that localized versions are updated accordingly and maintain consistency across languages.
Do not localize new pages unless explicitly required.
